scope: Alpha, Beta, Unlimited and Revised. Same cached scans, art, source wording and existing calibration UUIDs. Validation printings are reused validation. No new renderer defaults, runtime scan transforms or score generation published.
findings: A whole-frame scale/translation trades outer-border alignment against art and rules-box placement. Rejected as a general correction: Revised basic lands and duals regress on validation.

Blank artwork adds a synthetic contrast boundary to candidate gradients. Opaque-only printing-layer support plus a three-pixel derivative halo removes that influence. Perturbing every nonopaque source pixel leaves all retained gradients exactly unchanged in all 84 variants. Reference-side content at incorrect candidate positions is not proven isolated.

Alpha/Beta white calibration cards give consistent small edge offsets. Unlimited/Revised outer-border positions are consistent while inner art and rules-box positions vary together by roughly 1–3 pixels across calibration scans. Outer-strip certification alone does not establish interior registration. The cause is unverified; do not call it a renderer discrepancy or infer per-card runtime corrections.
Revised art-top opaque support is insufficient in several material groups; missing edge evidence is null, not perfect alignment. Other weak/noisy fits and search-boundary cases remain diagnostic.

Original type lines remain unverified for 912 faces and original rules for 16 Unlimited faces. Some fallback types already match, but these components must not be counted as verified printing accuracy before review. MTGJSON originalType in this cache often contains modern types and cannot replace scan-reviewed wording blindly.
next: Establish scan-only interior-frame anchors with independent fitting/selection/certification strips for Unlimited and Revised. Preserve historical outer-border poses and explicitly report disagreements instead of hiding genuine border shape errors.
Re-evaluate shared outer stock, art aperture and rules-box geometry separately; retain dedicated Revised land geometry unless a representative calibration and validation cohort supports changing it.
Verify any selected geometry in the actual painter before mana, material and typography fitting. Audit original wording sources before full-card scores.
